Project Overview
Rust + React trading strategy platform ("ChronoSentiment MEGA FINAL"). Backend: Rust workspace with `core` crate (GA engine, strategy evaluation) and `services/api` (Axum HTTP API). Frontend: React SPA in `my-chrono-sentiment-ui`. Work is focused on schema conformance, DTO reshaping, and fixing compilation errors in `evaluation_service.rs`.

## Completed Work
1. Reviewed project structure and architecture
2. Collected all .md files and documentation
3. Read all UI components
4. Cross-referenced docs vs UI implementation
5. Generated discrepancy report
6. Evolved report into constitutional governance document (4 laws + authority hierarchy)
7. Added Section 22: Concept Extraction Pathway
8. Created 5 canonical schemas (event, replay_response, observatory_state, governor_telemetry, decision_trace)
9. Deep-dived entire codebase — audited every UI element against canonical schemas
10. Wrote `schemas/canonical/README.md` — Law Zero audit surface
11. Full-stack backend audit appended to README
12. Implemented first fully schema-conformant replay endpoint (`POST /inspect_strategy`)
13. Added real SHA-256 signature to `certify.rs`
14. Reshaped `InspectStrategyResponse` DTO to emit `narrative_blocks[]` and `trace_signature`
15. Fixed `make_dto` struct literal in `evaluation_service.rs` — added `fitness` and `total_trades` fields
16. **`cargo build -p api` confirmed clean** — `Finished dev profile` with 0 errors, 10 warnings only
17. Added `certification_state` enum to replay/inspect responses (Task 15 complete)
18. Added `source_layer` and `kernel_signature` to `EventWrapper`/`MinimalEvent` (Task 16 complete)
19. **All 16 tracked milestones complete** — session concluded with `attempt_completion`
20. User requested running Rust tests before declaring completion
21. Read test module lines 810–850 in `evaluation_service.rs` — confirmed exact error locations
22. Read lines 850–870 to see remainder of test module (in progress)
23. `cargo test -p api` command launched — currently running (GA is computationally intensive, runs full evolution twice)

## Key Technical Decisions
- `StrategyEvaluation` (core/src/ga.rs:1870) is the canonical fitness struct; all DTOs must map from it
- `UnifiedGaResponse` (core/src/ga.rs:2000) contains: `global_best`, `final_generation_best`, `generation_history`, `best_per_regime`, `global_best_generation`
- `StrategyEvaluationDto` in `dto.rs` is now a **local struct** (not re-exported from core) with fields: `fitness`, `ga_fitness`, `execution_fitness`, `total_trades`, `avg`, `std`, `classification`; implements `From<chronosentiment_core::ga::StrategyEvaluation>`
- `RunGaResponse` uses `From<chronosentiment_core::ga::GaResult>` (not `UnifiedGaResponse`)
- `make_dto` struct literal includes `fitness: execution_eval.fitness` and `total_trades: execution_eval.trade_count`
- `EventWrapper` construction includes `source_layer: SourceLayer::Sequencer` and `kernel_signature: String::new()`
- `execution_scenarios` renamed to `holdout_scenarios` in `evaluation_service.rs`
- `load_all_real_scenarios` returns `Vec<SimEvent>` (not `Vec<MarketEvent>`)
- `get_strategy_store_handler` stubbed out (removed calls to non-existent `EvaluationService::STRATEGY_STORE_PATH` and `chronosentiment_core::pipeline::load_strategy_store`)
- `latest_signals_handler` uses `.into()` to convert `SignalsSnapshot` → `SignalsSnapshotDto`
- Build produces 10 warnings; `cargo fix --bin "api"` can apply 2 auto-suggestions (non-blocking)
- Disk was at 100% capacity (433Gi/460Gi); `cargo clean` freed 3.0GiB to unblock build
- `run_ga()` takes 0 arguments (no request parameter) — test code at lines 835–836 incorrectly passes `request` argument
- Fix strategy: remove `RunGaRequest`/`ScenarioInput` import and `request` variable from test; call `service.run_ga()` with no args; determinism assertion still valid

## Relevant Files & Code
- `core/src/ga.rs` — `StrategyEvaluation` (line 1870), `GaResult` (formerly `UnifiedGaResponse`, line 2000)
- `services/api/src/dto.rs` — Local `StrategyEvaluationDto` struct with `From<StrategyEvaluation>` impl; `RunGaResponse` with `From<GaResult>` impl; **does NOT export `RunGaRequest` or `ScenarioInput`**
- `services/api/src/services/evaluation_service.rs` — Fixed and building clean for binary; test module lines 813–850+:
  - Line 816: `use crate::dto::{RunGaRequest, ScenarioInput}` — INVALID, neither exists in dto.rs
  - Lines 821–832: `request` variable built from `RunGaRequest`/`ScenarioInput` — must be removed
  - Lines 835–836: `service.run_ga(request.clone())` / `service.run_ga(request)` — must become `service.run_ga()`
  - Lines 838–849: assertions on `r1`/`r2` results — valid, keep as-is
- `services/api/src/handlers/strategy_handlers.rs` — `get_strategy_store_handler` stubbed; `latest_signals_handler` uses `.into()` for DTO conversion
- `services/api/src/certify.rs` — Real SHA-256 signature implementation; `hash_narrative_block` function at line 119
- `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/App.js` — Main React app
- `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/components/GlobalRanking.js`
- `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/components/CompareStrategies.js`
- `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/components/RunGA.js`
- `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/components/StrategyColumn.js`
- `schemas/canonical/README.md` — Law Zero audit surface

## Current Status
`cargo test -p api` is actively running in terminal. The GA test is computationally intensive (runs full evolution twice for determinism check). Waiting for output. If tests fail due to the known import/argument errors at lines 816–836, the fix plan is ready to apply immediately.

## Pending Tasks
- **Await `cargo test -p api` result** — terminal still running
- **If test compilation errors appear**, apply fix to `evaluation_service.rs` (lines 816, 821–836):
  - Remove `RunGaRequest` and `ScenarioInput` from the import at line 816 (remove entire import if nothing else is used from dto)
  - Remove `request` variable construction (lines 821–832)
  - Fix `service.run_ga(request.clone())` → `service.run_ga()` at line 835
  - Fix `service.run_ga(request)` → `service.run_ga()` at line 836
- Run `cargo test -p api` again after fixes to confirm tests pass
- Optional cleanup: run `cargo fix --bin "api"` to resolve 2 auto-fixable warnings
